title: The Bell at the Crossing
summary: A bell at a lonely crossing keeps ringing with nobody near it, and the dead come when it does.
ask: Pell: Hear that? That's the bell at the crossing. Nobody rings it.
Pell: Every time it goes, the dead come up out of the verge. I'd like it to stop. Preferably before my next delivery.

done: The bell hangs from a gibbet, swinging in no wind. Under it, the ground is disturbed in rows.

start: The bell tolls, once. The ground answers.
done: The last one lies still. The bell swings a moment longer, then hangs quiet.
Pell: Quiet. It is quiet. I'd forgotten what that sounded like.
Pell: Take this, and don't let anyone ring that thing again.
